Literal In quorum fidem, etc. at20331 abbreviates only the conventional certification formula within that quotation; it is disclosed and retained without expansion, and no substantive body is replaced by reference. The synopsis historical note begins20260–20262 and explicitly resumes20319–20321 with rum continuing concessa-; both physical blocks belong to the same marked note20258 and are retained. Comparative references to Innocent XI and a later constitution do not replace the outer Clement XI protocol. Historical corrections20322 and20373 match celebrare at20302 and secretarius at20334 and remain uncorrected source notes. The complete concluding non-obstants and original dating20383–20385, plus editorial dating20387, are retained before next LIX at20390; previous act dating ends20249.
